what: Crepuscular Homunculus turns the FM-1 into a dark standalone synth and four-track groovebox, with 64 factory sounds spanning atmospheric pads, heavy bass, metallic textures, synthesized drums and six-operator FM. Build songs with four A–D banks per track, up to 64 steps, native piano-roll editing and saved swing, alongside reactive Homunculus and Thorn Rift displays. Play, edit and save on the FM-1 itself; no companion application is required.
